title: Manush-Diya Reach China Smash Mixed Doubles Semifinals
indian_angle: Indian Asian Games medallists Manush Shah and Diya Chitale continue their strong form by reaching the semifinals of an international tournament.
summary: Manush Shah and Diya Chitale, bronze medallists at the Asian Games 2026, have advanced to the mixed doubles semifinals at the China Smash 2026, where they will face Lin Yun-ju and Cheng I-ching.

title: Manav Thakkar Advances, Manika Batra Upsets World No. 27 at China Smash
indian_angle: Indian paddlers Manav Thakkar and Manika Batra secured significant wins at the China Smash, with Manika upsetting a higher-ranked opponent.
summary: Manav Thakkar defeated Simon Gauzy and is set to play Alexis Lebrun, while Manika Batra caused an upset by beating the World No. 27 at the China Smash 2026.

title: Manush and Diya's Journey to World-Class Table Tennis Partnership
indian_angle: This article highlights the development of Indian table tennis mixed doubles pair Manush Shah and Diya Chitale into a world-class combination, securing India's fourth Asian Games medal in the sport.
summary: A look into how Manush Shah and Diya Chitale evolved from a promising duo to a world-class mixed doubles pair, contributing to India's table tennis success at the Asian Games with a bronze medal.

title: Vithya Ramraj Targets Sub-54 Second Run After Breaking Usha's Record
indian_angle: Indian athlete Vithya Ramraj, fresh off breaking a 42-year-old national record held by P.T. Usha and winning three Asian Games medals, aims for a sub-54 second run and a World Championships final.
summary: After an impressive Asian Games performance, Vithya Ramraj, who broke P.T. Usha's 42-year-old 400m hurdles national record, is now focused on achieving a sub-54 second time and reaching the World Championships final.

title: Asian Games Archery Heroes Reunite for APL Season 2 in Hyderabad
indian_angle: India's top archers, including recent Asian Games medallists, are gathering in Hyderabad for the second season of the Archery Premier League, competing against both compatriots and international rivals.
summary: The second season of the Archery Premier League (APL) has commenced in Hyderabad, bringing together India's finest archers, many of whom were recent Asian Games medallists, to compete in a domestic league format.

title: Smriti Mandhana Appointed New India Women's Cricket Captain
indian_angle: Smriti Mandhana, a highly experienced player and two-time WPL winning captain, has been appointed as the new captain of the Indian women's cricket team, marking a significant development for Indian cricket.
summary: Smriti Mandhana, 30, has been named the new captain of the Indian women's cricket team, recognized for her experience and successful leadership in the WPL, with her immediate focus on strengthening the T20I squad.
